description: Maps keywords and file patterns to relevant skills for auto-activation

rules.message: This is a desktop app. Consider using /setup-pear-desktop for Pear desktop setup with React + styled-components.
This looks like a terminal/service app. Consider using /setup-pear-terminal for a headless Pear app.
This is a mobile app. Consider using /setup-mobile-app for Expo + Bare setup.
This involves P2P networking. Consider using /add-p2p-networking for Hyperswarm setup.
This involves P2P RPC. Consider using /add-p2p-rpc for bare-rpc request/response patterns.
This looks like a data sync task. Consider using /add-p2p-sync for Hypercore replication.
This involves secure messaging. Consider using /add-encrypted-channels for encrypted Protomux channels.
This is a storage pattern. Consider using /add-kv-storage for Hyperbee offline-first storage.
This involves structured data. Consider using /add-database for HyperDB with schema and indexes.
This involves file storage. Consider using /add-file-storage for Hyperdrive.
This involves AI inference. Consider using /add-ai-chat for QVAC chat, streaming, and tool calling.
This involves image analysis. Consider using /add-ai-vision for QVAC multimodal vision.
This involves audio transcription. Consider using /add-ai-transcription for QVAC Whisper.
This involves RAG/search. Consider using /add-ai-rag for QVAC embeddings and vector search.
This involves payments/wallet. Consider using /add-wallet for WDK patterns.
